_provenance.description: Authentic reference proteins for the default screening view.
_provenance.warning: These are real sequences. Do not describe heuristic scores over them as measured binding or selectivity.
_provenance.pdb_options: Verbatim UniProt PDB cross-references (method, resolution, chains) for the two lanmodulins, retrieved 2026-10-21. Which element each file holds is deliberately NOT restated here: catalog.deposited_rare_earths() derives it from ree_pdb_entries.json, so the two cannot drift apart. Carrying the alternatives is what lets a question about La3+ reach 8DQ2 instead of measuring the sharper Dy3+ file 8FNR and calling it an answer.

proteins.name: Lanmodulin
proteins.organism: Methylorubrum extorquens (strain ATCC 14718 / DSM 1338 / JCM 2805 / NCIMB 9133 / AM1)
proteins.evidence: experimentally characterized; Nd3+ sites resolved in PDB 8FNS
proteins.notes: Lanmodulin from Methylorubrum extorquens AM1. The one reviewed member of the family and the positive control for the pipeline.

proteins.name: Lanmodulin (Hansschlegelia quercus)
proteins.evidence: structure with bound Dy3+ deposited as PDB 8FNR
proteins.notes: Lanmodulin from Hansschlegelia quercus. A distinct site architecture from 8FNS: CN 9 with three bidentate carboxylates and no coordinating water.

proteins.name: Calmodulin-1
proteins.evidence: experimentally characterized calcium sensor; Ca2+ sites in PDB 1CLL
proteins.notes: Human calmodulin. Four EF-hands at coordination number 7. The key negative: it is calcium-selective, not lanthanide-selective.

proteins.name: Troponin C, skeletal muscle
proteins.notes: Human fast skeletal troponin C. A second EF-hand calcium protein, included because the sequence heuristic ranks it almost level with lanmodulin.

proteins.name: Hemoglobin subunit alpha
proteins.evidence: no EF-hand domain; oxygen transport via haem iron
proteins.notes: Human haemoglobin subunit alpha. Binds a metal, but through a porphyrin rather than a carboxylate-rich EF-hand.

proteins.name: Chymotrypsinogen A
proteins.evidence: serine protease zymogen; no characterized metal site
proteins.notes: Bovine chymotrypsinogen A. Included as an unrelated protein that should rank at the bottom.
